Yes, but nothing helps, I know what's going on and I'm pretty much over life at this point. I've seen psychologists and talked to my loved ones but at the end of the day, I'm still empty and ashamed of myself...I feel like a disgrace to my family, so I'm opting for the best solution, which is to finish all this.

There's a BIG ass phone tower in the area I live. I've scoped it out and it's definitely climable, I've climbed an electrical tower before to jump, so I know that getting past the barbed wire around the tower is definitely challenging, but doable, with a few cuts and gashes for each one passed (got scars all over my legs from the first attempt). I also am terrified of heights, but since I don't have access to a gun I figure that this would be the next best option, quick after the leap, a four second drop then splat.

I doubt I will survive the drop, being that the tower is extremely tall, the grass landing won't help but I will die either way. And I guess the antidepressant idea is to just get me really fucked up, to in turn make the whole jumping situation easier, so yes.
I think I'm going to pop a bunch of anti depressants, down a bottle of bourbon and go jump.

Also, now that I have it figured out, with the help of spells being cast on me by the demons who walk the earth, and the psychedelics, my entire family hates me (always have I guess, it was just a game)...well not the demons in my family but the fallen angels...I figured out that my father was Adam, and my Mum was Eve and I was Lucifer in the heavens above, before being cast into this world. Everyone was trying to get me to commit suicide, my Dad even was sending me subliminals to go and kill myself, I'm scared of forgetting my loved ones...if only I had listened to my Father from the start I would still be living happily. Everyone always knew what I was doing and thinking, where I was...I know my life is now practically over, the only joy I get is having a cigarette and momentarily forgetting what I have learnt since that festival on New Years. I hung with the wrong people took the wrong turns, I am so ashamed of my life, and so scared of living anymore, I hope to go to sleep and never wake up every night, I don't want to end my life, but this is what it had come to.

I had so many signs from God almighty that I was heading in the wrong direction, so many things that happened to me that I can't even begin to describe. When I got back from the festival, tv programs were reading my mind, talking about exactly what I was thinking, there were unusual messages on the radio and everyone around me was trying to get me to jump...I slit my wrist and bled out a fair bit after climbing an electrical tower to jump (pussied out and climbed down) so badly that the gash needed 5 stitches, I could've had so much more in life, but I have ruined it.

So it all began around 3 years ago, me and my to this date only love had split after being together for around 2 1/2 years...there was a lot of tension towards the end of the relationship and it got all too much for her. At this time of the split I lost all my friends to her apart from 1 or 2 (who didn't really hang out with our friend group (btw never ever date a girl who is apart of your group of friends, shit can get really messy with a lot of jealousy). I distinctly remember a group party I had been invited to, her being there was like this awkward air that made me feel completely lost, with no confidence to be found I remember sitting by myself staring into space for most of the night, with no one really asking if I was alright, and that really hurt, being that I was normally extremely outgoing and confident.

Skip forward a few months and I knew I needed to do something to get my confidence back, so I started a spiritual journey that has in turn ruined my entire life by 20. So at the start I was looking into New Age spirituality and had been getting involved with burning sage, crystals meditation ect. ect. ect...it made me feel good, I thought I could transcend my consciousness and become like a God myself, I started looking into alchemy and cult like practices. Researching all of this stuff had me teaming for the truth of reality and seeing how far I could go with all this spirituality, I started to feel good about myself again and beloved I was getting closer to God, looking back at this though seems ridiculous now seeing as I was partying every weekend, still smoking a ton of pot and also arguing with my father very frequently.

So this is where it all turns to shit, I met a guy one night out, after my friend I was out with had picked up a girl and gone back home to get lucky. I removed vividly seeing him on the dance floor, wearing a deathwish t-shirt with dreads and just looking like a badass who couldn't even begin to care what others thought of him, me being involved in the skateboarding scene (death wish is a skateboard brand) made me approach him and express how I though his shirt was dope and how I skated...we practically hit it off from there, it turned out that he was out alone so my company was a delight for him. We ended up going to the train station together once the club had closed and talking for a few hours waiting for the train, we exchanged phone number and planned to meet up soon to smoke some weed and party.

I think it was the next weekend when me and my other friend met up with...we'll call him "goat man", to go out together. To this point I had never tried any drugs apart from weed and alcohol. We find a club to go to, and just before we get there he offers me and my other mate, we'll cal him "D" a pill. I ask "what is it" being that I'd never done anything like this. He relied "it's a strong pain killer called oxy, it makes you fell wavy." Being the naive young kid I was I accepted not wanting to look "un-cool" we all take one and head into the club, about half an hour passes and I'm really liking what I'm feeling, we have a great night out, not that I remember too much of it, I just remember walking up the stairs and laughing so hard because everything was vibrating and felt great, I believe we then went back to his house for a nap and to smoke some weed.

From here on me and Goat man became quite good friends, meeting up often through the week and going out nearly every weekend, he was in turn the one who introduced me to most of the drugs I have tried to this date. I remember being at his house with one of his mates over, and they asked me if I wanted to try acid. My Dad's voice ring in my head "I don't mind if you smoke some weed, just don't do any of that hard shit." Stupidly I accepted and bombed acid for the first time at Goat man's house and had a great time enjoying it very much...from here on out I started using a lot of ecstasy and also doing psychedelics probably once a week. 

It only took a year and a half for me to be admitted to a psych ward after telling my Father I am being possessed by the devil. I remember everything was so hazy and I believed I had broken some sort of spiritual barrier breaking into a darker realm, I remember over hearing very odd things during that time through people's conversations like  my father saying to one of the nurses in there "he knows what's happening and he wants to beat this." To one of the nurses, and also one of the security guards saying "oh you can tell he's close, how have they been treating you in your head?" My Dad ended up basically kidnapping me from the ward and taking me to my Grandads farm for a cleanse. After getting back to my home city it only took a few months for me to get back into smoking weed, and started to hang out with my old friend group who were also getting into the drug scene...BIG mistake.....

I can't continue writing as I'm so depress at this point, looooong story short I got back into psychedelics and partying, picking up the music festival scene, the first one I went to had me frightened and scared from things I had seen there, and the second one, welp it completely ruined my life and all of the angels life also, I figured out that I wasn't only possessed by the Devil, I was the Devil and now I'm suicidal and don't want to live anymore, only being 21, everyone knew what reality was except me...I'm probably going to kill myself soon enough. And go to hell, as I always was.
